controls.title: Configuration
controls.summary: Security misconfiguration occurs when applications, frameworks, or infrastructure use insecure defaults, unnecessary features, or improperly configured security controls. OpenCRE: 180-488, 462-245, 623-347

controls.title: Exposure of Sensitive Information
controls.summary: Sensitive information exposure occurs when applications inadvertently reveal data that can be used by attackers — through error messages, logs, API responses, or verbose configurations. OpenCRE: 713-683, 743-110, 227-045

controls.title: Path Traversal
controls.summary: Path traversal occurs when user-controlled input is used to construct file paths without canonicalization, allowing access to files outside intended directories. OpenCRE: 675-168

controls.title: Improper Authentication
controls.summary: Improper authentication allows attackers to bypass identity verification, impersonate users, or access protected resources without valid credentials. OpenCRE: 813-610, 605-735, 816-631

controls.title: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
controls.summary: Use of broken or risky cryptographic algorithms undermines data confidentiality and integrity, allowing attackers to decrypt, forge, or tamper with protected data. OpenCRE: 742-431, 002-801, 504-340

controls.title: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
controls.summary: CSRF forces authenticated users to submit unintended requests, enabling attackers to perform state-changing actions on behalf of victims. OpenCRE: 464-084, 060-472

controls.title: Session Fixation
controls.summary: Session fixation allows attackers to set a victim's session identifier before authentication, then hijack the authenticated session. OpenCRE: 002-630

controls.title: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
controls.summary: Deserialization of untrusted data can lead to remote code execution, object injection, or denial of service when applications reconstruct objects from attacker-controlled serialized input. OpenCRE: 831-563, 736-554, 762-616

controls.title: Insufficient Logging
controls.summary: Insufficient logging prevents detection of security breaches, hinders forensic analysis, and delays incident response when critical security events go unrecorded. OpenCRE: 184-284, 841-710, 555-048

controls.title: OS Command Injection
controls.summary: OS command injection occurs when untrusted data is passed to system shell commands without proper sanitization, allowing attackers to run arbitrary commands. OpenCRE: 857-718, 683-722

controls.title: Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
controls.summary: Cross-site scripting occurs when untrusted data is included in web output without proper encoding, allowing attackers to run scripts in victim browsers. OpenCRE: 366-835

controls.title: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
controls.summary: Hard-coded credentials in source code, configuration files, or system prompts can be extracted by attackers to gain unauthorized access to systems and services. OpenCRE: 551-054, 774-888, 340-375

controls.title: SQL Injection
controls.summary: SQL injection occurs when untrusted data is sent to a database interpreter as part of a query, allowing attackers to read, modify, or delete data. OpenCRE: 064-808, 732-873
